batch_node.name: rampart-20x-playground inventory software v0.2.0
batch_node.description: The software the git-serious web image carries. Packages, source packages and the library rows come from the CycloneDX 1.7 SBOM that the publish-images workflow attested for ghcr.io/unified-systems-com/tap-web (arm64 image sha256:48e30963aa6e9786bba6cbea65c391f830f435fe15360fd87f0bd80f47eb56a4, document produced 2026-10-16T04:17:51Z by syft 1.51.0). The attestation was checked with gh attestation verify (signer https://github.com/unified-systems-com/tap/.github/workflows/publish-images.yml@refs/heads/main) and the rows were produced by computing_core's parse_cyclonedx from the signed bytes. Seeded by hand, because no SBOM carries them: the container host, the Wolfi row with its pinned base-image digest (Dockerfile), the cryptography library (pyproject no-binary-package list), and the crypto providers (crypto-BOM scan, scope tap-web, taken from an earlier image: the scan saw curl 8.22.0-r4 and openssl 3.6.5-r1, which the current SBOM lists as 8.23.0-r0 and 3.6.5-r2, so those two providers are attached to the current version of the same package). Every entity carries dcom=design (req-rampart-20x-playground-inventory-software). The container host is not stamped overview. No key material, fingerprint or file content is recorded.
